summary: Algoma Steel Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 30, 2026, containing a press release that provides operational guidance for the second quarter of 2026. The company expects total steel shipments of 175,000 to 180,000 tons and Adjusted EBITDA of $5 million to $15 million, including a $45 million insurance settlement and a $50-$55 million capacity utilization adjustment. There is no special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change. The filing is routine and forward-looking only.
